english.note: Use this for giving in to a temptation or desire rather than simply surrendering to an external force.

examples.english: I had promised to give up sweets, but I still succumb to temptation whenever I see cake.
examples.traditional: 我明明話咗戒甜品，一見到蛋糕就受唔住誘惑。
